title: UOP communications and removal notifications — follow-up to W012328
summary:
W012328-031226 received 'no responsive records' for SMPD communications about UOP and for agency-removal records, plus 'I did not locate a log of this information in the Flock platform.'

W012297-030826 subsequently produced a 2025-12-03 Flock email to an SMPD inbox naming UOP among 10 pending share requests.

This request re-asks the UOP-communications question citing the later-produced email, asks for removal notifications in the relevant window, and asks for the search methodology used on W012328.

policy_promises.tests: What search methodology was used to respond to W012328 items 1 and 2?

prior_pra_refs.note: W012328 received 'no responsive records' on UOP communications. W012297 then produced a Flock email naming UOP. This request re-asks with the later-produced record cited.
W012297 produced the 2025-12-03 Flock email naming UOP.

filed_because: Follow-up after a 'no records' response was followed by another PRA producing matching records. Asks for a corrected answer on UOP and a description of the original search.
notes:
Closed on 2026-05-05 by consolidation into W012462-040226's email corpus.

The search-methodology question is outside the scope of an inbound-mail-only corpus.
